reuse.why: Extends the existing shouldWriteMonthBudget predicate, reuses averageToBudgetAmount for the new action's sign and extractTagsFromText for the #fixed tag, but each action still builds its own category query.

duplication.why: The same notes join and saved-template SQL expression is pasted into five separate queries (getBudgetData, setZero, setLastMonthSpending, set3/6/12MonthAvg) instead of one shared month-action category query.

placement.why: Selection rules live in month-action.ts and actions stay in actions.ts as the tree organises them; the data the rules need is fetched ad hoc per action.

scope.why: Changes stay within the four requested behaviours; the reformatting of existing queries is incidental to adding columns.

maintainability.why: The decision is centralised in one predicate, but any change to how template or group-note data is fetched must be repeated in five SQL strings.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Every month-wide action calls shouldWriteMonthBudget; the hidden filter was removed from the averages' SQL so it is decided only in the predicate.

disguised_duplication.where: The repeated SQL fragment in actions.ts is an overt copy with only whitespace differences, not a reshaped one.

abstraction_drift.where: shouldWriteMonthBudget lost its per-action discriminator and gained only the includeHiddenCategories flag plus general rule conditions (template, #fixed); all six month-wide actions call it, although each feeds it from its own duplicated query.
